title: finding(fields): the record picker's display column still renders `titleFormat` above `nameField`, so after objectui#10479 the lookup dropdown and the picker label the same record differently
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupColumnDisplay.tsx` (`renderLookupColumnValue`, the display-column step).

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) at the ACCEPT of objectui#10343 (PR objectui#10479). It comes from the dev's `out_of_scope_findings` (class b) and the at-tier contract review of that PR, which both measured it. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

objectui#10479 moved the lookup **dropdown** option label onto `@object-ui/core`'s `getRecordDisplayName`. The order is now the field's own `displayField`, then the object's `nameField`, then the deprecated `titleFormat`: the lookup branch of objectui#9436 ruling C1. The browse-all **record picker's display column** was outside that claim and still does it the old way. `renderLookupColumnValue` renders `titleFormat` first, through its own private single-brace renderer.

⇒ On an object that declares both `nameField` and `titleFormat`, the same record reads differently:

| surface | label |
|:--|:--|
| lookup dropdown option (after PR objectui#10479) | the `nameField` value, e.g. `HT-001` |
| record picker, display column | the rendered template, e.g. `Globex / HT-001` |

Before PR objectui#10479 both surfaces read the template, so this PR creates the disagreement. A double-brace template also still keeps its outer braces in the picker column (`{Globex} / {HT-001}`). Spec 17.4.0's `titleFormat` describe says the two placeholder spellings are equivalent: the title renderers normalize the double-brace form to the single-brace one before substituting.

## Contract

- `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, `titleFormat` describe: "[DEPRECATED → nameField (ADR-0079)] … an explicit nameField now takes precedence".
- objectui#9436 ruling C1 (maintainer 「同意」): the declared pointer outranks `titleFormat`. The record page (`ba0b61a`) and the lookup dropdown (PR objectui#10479) now follow it.

## Reproduction

The dev ran a throwaway probe at PR head `600c330`, not committed. The object has `nameField: 'contract_no'` and `titleFormat: '{party} / {contract_no}'`. The dropdown reads `['HT-001']`, and the picker's name column reads `Globex / HT-001`. The existing pin in `LookupField.candidateExpand-10223` (`C-0 - samepick_task_0` in the name column) shows template-over-column too. ⚠️ These are the dev's readings, confirmed at source by the reviewer (`lookupColumnDisplay.tsx:190-208` at head); the seat did not re-run them.

## Fix direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Route the display column through the same `getRecordDisplayName` call the dropdown and the read cell use, rather than a third copy of the ladder. That way the three lookup surfaces cannot drift again.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (the search API answers 403 here), oldest updated 2026-09-18T06:33Z. Pattern `lookupColumnDisplay|renderLookupColumnValue|picker … (display|name) column … titleFormat` ⇒ 3 hits: PR objectui#10479 (the origin), PR objectui#10459 and PR objectui#10341. The last two are unrelated PRs that mention the file. No issue. Lit control `recordToOption` ⇒ 4 hits, so the instrument is lit. ⇒ No duplicate.
